summary: Iteration 3: Verified gradient image fallback + legal footer disclaimer + i18n toggle. Backend regression (18/18) passed. Frontend: footer-disclaimer present on both home and article pages, contains Hindi 'अस्वीकरण एवं विधिक सूचना' body + गाजियाबाद/उत्तर प्रदेश jurisdiction clause; language-toggle flips entire disclaimer (title/body/jurisdiction) to English with 'Disclaimer & Legal Notice' and 'Legal Jurisdiction ... Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh'. No broken icons on home: all 29 current news cards render as CSS gradient fallback tiles (0 real tags, 0 images with naturalWidth==0, 0 image request failures). Each gradient tile shows category_hi + 'गाजियाबाद टाइम्स'. Admin compose dialog features (video/STT/paste/ai-enhance) regression-covered in iteration_2 and backend remains green.
